title: Initiative
description: Groups projects toward an outcome (design part 3.2). In the files backend the body holds the sections Why, Done when, Plan and Notes; this schema covers the front matter. Derived fields (claimed, ready, blocked, stage, critical_path, lead_time) are never stored.

owner.description: Who is accountable for this record. Defaults to the owner: the person who holds the project's decision rights.

opened_from.description: Signal, opportunity or decision IDs this was opened from.
